project: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 — Dancing with the SARs

circular_validation_guard.rule: SAR-derived candidate masks cannot validate SAR-derived candidate masks (Circular Validation Fallacy).

local_reference_inventory.blocking_notice: Independent scientific validation is currently BLOCKED because no independent ground truth (optical cloud-masked water masks, BWDB river stage gauges, or DEM/HAND rasters) exists locally in the workspace. Governance rules strictly prohibit downloading external datasets or inventing observations.

tier_1_flood_event_documentation.definition: Government situation reports (NDRCC/DMB), humanitarian assessments (NIRAPAD, UN OCHA), and news records.
tier_1_flood_event_documentation.scientific_status: Confirms regional flood occurrence; does not provide pixel-level boundary truth.

tier_2_hydrological_corroboration.definition: BWDB/FFWC daily river stage readings at Kazipur and Sirajganj gauge stations.
tier_2_hydrological_corroboration.scientific_status: Provides 1D hydraulic temporal corroboration (e.g. water level relative to Danger Level); does not delineate 2D spatial inundation footprint.

tier_3_pixel_level_reference_validation.definition: Concurrent high-resolution optical water masks (Sentinel-2 MSI 10m/20m or Landsat 8/9 30m) with cloud/shadow masking.
tier_3_pixel_level_reference_validation.scientific_status: Provides direct spatial ground truth for confusion matrix and IoU metrics.

tier_4_terrain_contextual_assessment.definition: Copernicus GLO-30 DEM, FABDEM, and Height Above Nearest Drainage (HAND).
tier_4_terrain_contextual_assessment.scientific_status: Provides topographic plausibility checks (depressions vs terraces) and layover/shadow boundaries; not dynamic water truth.

sentinel_2.band_selection: B03 (Green, 10m), B08 (NIR, 10m), B11 (SWIR1, 20m), B12 (SWIR2, 20m), SCL (Scene Classification Layer, 20m)
sentinel_2.cloud_shadow_masking: Mask SCL values 3 (Cloud Shadow), 7 (Low Proba Cloud), 8 (Med Proba Cloud), 9 (High Proba Cloud), 10 (Cirrus), 11 (Snow/Ice)
sentinel_2.spatial_alignment: Bicubic / area-weighted aggregation to common 20m grid (EPSG:32645) matching june10_aligned.tif
sentinel_2.monsoon_constraint: Heavy cloud cover during June-July monsoon in Bangladesh requires multi-day temporal search window (+/- 5 days of SAR epoch)

landsat_8_9.cloud_masking: Dilated cloud bit 1, Cirrus bit 2, Cloud bit 3, Cloud Shadow bit 4
landsat_8_9.spatial_alignment: Reproject and bilinear resample from 30m to 20m EPSG:32645

hydrological_gauge_specification.source_authority: Bangladesh Water Development Board (BWDB) / Flood Forecasting and Warning Centre (FFWC)

key_stations_preliminary_reference.notes: Preliminary literature value; requires official BWDB bulletin citation.

vertical_datum.notes: Exact geodetic offset against Survey of Bangladesh (SoB) MSL requires local benchmark monument verification.

floodplain_elevation_range_m.notes: Unverified regional rule-of-thumb; must not be used as active filter without local DEM.

hand_connectivity_threshold_m.notes: Unverified threshold; requires hydrodynamic drainage calibration.

barind_tract_pleistocene_elevation_m.notes: Regional geomorphological assumption; no local DEM present.

validation_utility: Assess topographic plausibility of candidate inundation (water flows downhill).
Examine hydraulic connectivity between candidate water and the active river network.
Delineate potential radar shadow and layover along tall embankments.
CRITICAL: DEM/HAND information is supporting terrain context, NOT independent flood ground truth.

spatial_block_validation_ml_protocol.motivation: Prevent spatial autocorrelation data leakage between training and testing sets in future ML classifiers.
spatial_block_validation_ml_protocol.design: Spatial block cross-validation (5 km x 5 km grid blocks with 500 m exclusion buffer / halo zones between folds).
spatial_block_validation_ml_protocol.metric_reporting: Report spatially stratified IoU and Balanced Accuracy across independent blocks.
